steps.input: How many hectares does the dune system at Duneholt Sand Dune Reserve cover?
steps.output:
[doc-30#c0] Duneholt Sand Dune Reserve was designated in 1993 to protect the only extensive dune system in the archipelago.

[doc-30#c2] The dune system covers 340 hectares and its highest dune rises 34 metres above the beach. The seaward dune front retreats by roughly 1.2 metres per year.

[doc-30#c1] Dune movement is tracked by repeat survey of a fixed grid, and vegetation is recorded in permanent quadrats on the stabilised inland dunes.

[doc-01#c0] Vellmar Station was established in 1962 by the Kessner Maritime Trust on the northern shore of Hallen Island. It was the first permanent installation in the Kessner Archipelago and remains the administrative centre for the six northern stations.
